heading: Today
text: Patchy fog, then partly sunny, very warm and very humid. A spotty shower or storms.

heading: Friday Night
text: Partly cloudy, muggy.  A rising chance of a few showers or storms, mostly after midnight.

heading: Saturday
text: A good chance of showers, thunderstorms north, scattered south.

heading: Sunday
text: Partly sunny. A stray shower or thunderstorm.
